look_here_first: Compare leaf breadth, lower-surface pubescence, acorn shape, geography, and Q. fusiformis overlap. Ambiguous Central Texas live oaks should remain unresolved.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: typical acorns broadly ovoid to barrel-shaped with blunt or rounded apex

lookalikes.differences: Q. fusiformis is the priority comparison; geography plus acorn and leaf morphology matters more than any one trait.
